_comment: The excitation-window check of the BVA window (drawn under the Input section by gui/app.py): the donor and acceptor micro-time ranges held against the excitation pulses of the measurements the last run read.

sections.description: The donor and acceptor micro-time ranges held against the excitation pulses the measurements show (the check every PIE analysis runs): a warning when a range leaves out a pulse its detector sees, holds almost none of its photons or lies beyond the data's channels. Detectors of the setup on the same routing channels are checked with the pair (PIE's prompt/delayed split of one detector). The BVA result is not changed by it.
The offer of the detected gates, shown when the donor or acceptor ranges do not match the data.

buttons.label: Use detected windows
buttons.description: Take the micro-time gates detected from the measurement's decays as the donor and acceptor ranges and run BVA again (an automatic update does; otherwise press Run). The burst selection is not changed, and the saved detector setup is not written.
